All flows work.

action_items: Investigate landing hero text contrast — heading appears washed-out light gray on white background on desktop viewport 1920x1080. Verify Tailwind/CSS color tokens for landing title.

Current behavior (disabled button + no error) is UX-valid and prevents submission, but if the intent is to also show inline guidance, add an aria-live message or enable the button and set formError on submit.

test files use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with hardcoded fallback 'sme-health-check.preview.emergentagent.com' — should use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and drop the stale fallback.
